title: Add webapp template: client entry point and App.tsx
description: Create the React entry point (main.tsx) and root App component (App.tsx) for the client template. main.tsx sets up React 19 with QueryClientProvider and RouterProvider. App.tsx provides a basic routing shell.

steps.details: Create src/templates/webapp/client/src/main.tsx: import React from 'react'; import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client'; import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'; import { RouterProvider, createBrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom'; import App from './App'; import './index.css'; const queryClient = new QueryClient(); const router = createBrowserRouter([{ path: '/', element: <App /> }]); ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}><RouterProvider router={router} /></QueryClientProvider>);

Create src/templates/webapp/client/src/index.css with Tailwind v4 imports: @import 'tailwindcss';
Create src/templates/webapp/client/index.html with standard Vite HTML shell: DOCTYPE, meta viewport, title {{PROJECT_NAME}}, div#root, and script src='/src/main.tsx' type='module'.

technicalNotes: React 19 uses ReactDOM.createRoot (same as React 18) — the API didn't change for basic mounting
